nom: BOBBI BROWN Vitamin Enriched Eye Base Primer & Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

avis.texte: I tried to love this product, but everytime I used it - I broke out in a rash! There is a fragrance to the product that may attributed to the irritation, but I couldn't get behind this product unfortuantely. Great moisturaization though!

I have looked everywhere for the perfect undereye primer to cover my dark circles and genetic undereye bags. this stuff does the trick! I have found it was not as moisturizing for me as others have found it. But if I apply my moisturizer with a small amount of Vaseline or aquaphor and then this primer, my makeup goes on super smoothly and blends seamlessly and my under eyes stay hydrated all day. no issues with milia. my favorite makeup to put on top is BB color corrector stick and a little tarte creamy concealer

avis.titre: What are you using it for
avis.texte: There is a lot of mixed reviews. Question is what are you using it for. Personally, its only used as a primer before makeup. When it dries it doesnt peel and roll - especially after adding concealer. You also want to find a concealer that is the same ingredients. My favorite is Lancome serum concealer - love that it isnt heavy and it's moisturizing. If you're using it as a night cream you're wasting your money. Bummer is cost but i only purchase twice a year. A little goes a long way.

This is my ride of die eye cream for sure, definitely the best eye prep cream before makeup. They are soooo hydrated without but not greasy, and it last for a good amount of time. It makes your under eye makeup look smoother and last longer.

avis.titre: I will use this product FOREVER...
avis.texte: I have been using this product for about 1 1/2 years. It is the only thing in my many years that has diminished puffiness and deep circles enough that I can let it absorb in and wear makeup over it flawlessly. Thank you Bobbi Brown. Please don't ever change or stop making this Eye Base.
This is, hands down, the best under eye primer i have ever used. None if my concealer creases when inuse it. I will buy this over and over.
It feels like any nice moisturizer, but it smells very strongly to me like a citronella candle. Also, it's pretty expensive for what it is. You're paying for the brand name.

avis.titre: Hydrates and concealer lasts all day.
avis.texte: I first purchased the face base, and wasn't sure if I needed the eye primer. The eye primer is very different from the face base and completes my makeup. I read some of the negative reviews and I disagree. Maybe they applied too much, you only need a very small amount. I also am an avid fan of One Size setting spray for it's matte finish and LONG LASTING WEAR.
This is lightweight and moisturizing. My concealer and powders lay nicely over top. This is my second purchase!
I just bought this thinking it was fhe bigger size cause it was half off. Its literally so small. I am ticked that the price and amount of product dont match at all. What a scam.

avis.titre: I will use this product FOREVER...
avis.texte: I purchased this for the first time last year, at the suggestion of an ULTA store consultant. I LOVE THIS PRODUCT!! I have found the best product I have ever used to reduce the look of my lifelong dark circles under my eyes. I am so thankful! I finally have a system for reducing circles under my makeup, as follows: Bobbi Brown eye base and let dry; Bobbi Brown Skin Color Correcting Stick applied directly on the circle and feathered out with a brush; Estee Lauder Double Wear Foundation; and lastly, Tarte Creamy Concealer directly on and feathered out; and finally Laura Mercier Blur Setting Powder. I wanted to put this in my review to help others with the same concerns.

avis.titre: I will use this product FOREVER...
avis.texte: I have struggled with purple-dark circles under my eyes for my entire life. I have tried to understand the source and find a solution. FINALLY, someone at ULTA suggested BB Eye Base. Thank God! A combination of this product under the BB Color Corrector Stick, then EL foundation, then Tarte Creamy Concealer, and finally Laura Mercier Blur setting powder, I have found the perfect solution. I cannot tell you how thankful I am. Buy this and try it with an accurate color match under your foundation. Thank you Bobbi Brown!!
This primer does absolutely nothing for me. There is no difference in my under eyes. When I apply concealer, it creases worse than when I don't apply anything. Waste of money. :(

I've been using it for a week now. Can't say I've seen any changes, but I didn't expect it. Goes on nicely, isn't oily. I'll keep using it in hopes that it helps. As I've gotten older, my undereyes have started to get that sunken look. Here's hopin.
It's ok - very expensive. It seems to hydrate initially, but then my under eye area is dry again shortly after. This will be my last purchase of this and the face base.

I had high hopes for this eye cream after reading the reviews but it did not work for me. Zero hydration. I've been using it morning and night and my undereye feels dry within ten minutes of applying. Luckily I purchased this while it was on sale but sad I've already thrown away the packaging and can not return it.

avis.titre: Best under eye cream moisturizer on the market!
avis.texte: My husband and I use this daily. It glides on like butter but is not greasy. It really refreshes the skin under the eye and keeps it well hydrated

I received Bobbi Brown primer and moisturiser ad a sample and could not believe how amazing this product is. My makeup goes on so smooth it makes me look 5 years younger because I have dry skin and need a really good moisturiser. Great product!
Your employees were advising to try Bobbi Brown products so I did Eye moisturizer made my eyes itchy and concealer was dry looking No Thanks
It sucks under makeup, it makes it dry and flaky. When i tried wearing it without makeup it had a white cast and made me look ashy.

I should work for bobbi brown the way I promote their products! I highly recommend this & the primer/ moisturizer base. A little goes a long way. I use bobbi brown pressed powder over this & it stays on all day. I work in a hot environment (no ac) and never have issues with my make up.
With all the good reviews I had high hopes for this, but it made my undereye concealer look worse - patchy and creased. So it's a no for me and at this price I returned it.

Been a fan of face base for sometime & recently decided to try the eye base. When used over my eye moisturizer I found my tinted moisturizer (BM complexion rescue) pilled. Used alone and it was a good primer NOT great as after about 4 hours there was some settling in lines. I find my eye moisturizer is more hydrating & longer lasting. I have used the face base up to and around my eyes over my own eye moisturizer....better results. The extra step, the extra $, creasing and less moisturizing gives it a 3....may yield better results on someone younger and/or that follows up with BB foundation.

avis.titre: Great for under eye wrinkles and creases
avis.texte: It actually works! I had creases under my eyes after applying concealer with primer. I used this one time and I saw results! I applied this moisturizer before using primer and concealer and my creases were very minimum. I will continue using

I bought this to try when it was half off and I am so happy that I tried this product since using it. This is the only primer I touch my under eyes look beautiful. This is truly a phenomenal product that I will never be without.
This is great I have used it for over 2 years. It helps my under eye (Bobbie brown) cream last all day.

avis.titre: So light weight but packs a punch
avis.texte: Love a lightweight moisturizer that plumps, hydrates, and primes the eyes for concealer. Also love the uplifting scent that's not overpowering for my sensitive eyes.

I have been very conscious of the ingredients in my skincare and I am shocked at how many fragrance ingredients are in this eye cream!! Over 7! Along with all the other borderline questionable ingredients. HARD PASS.

This cream is amazing!! It works incredible for mature skin with many under-eye wrinkles & crows feet. It softens lines, moisturiex and definitely keeps my concealer and BB color correcter from settling into lines. It and the BBface base are the best primers I have ever used! The smell is wonderful too.

If you have dry skin, this one is perfect for you! A little goes a long way, and it smells amazing. The smell is what makes me love the product even more, a very fresh scent! It gives a beautiful radiance to your skin.
It has a grapefruit scent that is overpowering and people should know before they buy the product
It's gorgeous, it smells nice (but not fragrant). Plumps the under eye, my Tom Ford concealer looks amazing with it but so does my color pop concealer. Get it.
I use this product as a primer before I put it on my concealer. It really seems to help with the lines.

I notice a night and day difference when I use this product under my concealer or not. I always do an eye cream prior as well. It smooths my under eye and I feel my makeup goes on smoother too. I recently turned 40 and wanted to improve my skincare/ primer/base. I think this would benefit any age, but especially those who have under eye wrinkles and/or bags. I use all over my eye, not just underneath. It's expensive but a little goes a long way. I'll definitely buy this again.

Hands down the BEST eye-base and under eye primer! My eyeshadow and liner stayed put all day! I have fine lines under my eyes that tend to crepe up after wearing concealer but this stuff diminishes them so well. I highly recommend this product!

This product is horrible. Please do not waste any money on it. It's greasy, it causes makeup to SLIDE OFF, it gets in your eyes and is literally impossible to remove because it is like putting oil on your eyeball.

avis.titre: Another great product- A MUST HAVE- in every makeup case.
avis.texte: Each morning my skin is starving and it is fed with this amazing product! Thank you-
Your concealer will never look better! Great wear and texture. Notice a HUGE difference to wear this is now a staple for me!

Makes my under eyes so smooth! Concealer goes on wonderfully over it. I combine with the ordinary caffeine under eye serum. So good! I'm young but have very dry skin. Love this hydrating product and will definitely repurchase it when I run out.

avis.titre: It says primer but its not a primer for eye makeup
avis.texte: I saw Bobby Brown and "eye primer" and bought this thinking this was an eye primer for eye makeup. Its not.. This is an eye primer meaning it's a moisturizer for the eyelid and eye area BEFORE the eye make up primer like urban decay is applied. Expensive mistake. Its a nice moisturizer but it should be called just "Eye Moisturizer" and take the misleading "Primer" out of the name.

Finally!!…I found an under eye moisturizer and primer that actually works like it says it does. It set my concealer in seconds and along with a setting powder it didn't settle into my fine lines. I use it around the lines around my mouth, too!
Use very little and apply concealer before it dries down. I am obsessed with how well this has helped my fine lines and keeps my concealer from separating.
I apply this after my eye cream and face primer and prior to my under eye color corrector. It keeps the under eye hydrated.
I purchased this product for Ulta 21 days of beauty! It's very moisturizing and a little goes a long way! It's a good buy.
Every day before my make up. Trying to get rid of puffy bags and dark circles.

I never would of thought that moisturizing under my eyes would make such a difference in my concealer application. I apply this. Let it set for a few minutes. Then add my concealer. Makes it look smoother and less in my fine lines & wrinkles.

I bought this on beauty steals at half off and wow will I be buying it full price when I run out. It is 100% worth the price tag! I have really deep lines around my eyes and only after a week of use they're almost entirely gone. I'm in shock at how fast and effective this product is.
I have only used this eye cream for a week! I haven't seen any improvements in my eye area. But, I do like how it feels.

avis.auteur: Mommy's tired. So, SO very tired.
avis.texte: I don't think I feel or appear to be more awake when I use this. But not sure what could really help 2 hours of sleep besides MORE SLEEP (…and possibly not getting kicked by a 5 year old all night who wakes up running and jumping onto your bed after you've only slept an hour or two but he tosses and turns all night keeping you from falling into a deep sleep.) Anyways, it keeps my eye area looking more fresh than cakey when I'm layering on the products to hide my genetic-plus lack of sleep-dark circles. My under eyes are so sensitive to eye creams. Out of all of the jars and tubes of eye creams I have in my cabinet, only a few do not cause red bumps under my eyes. This is one of those that do not cause red bumps. It's quite amazing that it doesn't, considering it's a "primer" - I was sure it wouldn't work out for me. But I had tried a tiny jar of it awhile back and knew I needed to buy the full size, and I'm very happy that I did. I do use this over my eye cream after that soaks in. Foundation and/or concealer looks nice over it and doesn't do anything weird like separating the makeup. It keeps my under eyes from looking too dry, as I have super dry under eyes when left without products. It's quite creamy, almost a liquid-like cream, and a pale custard-cream shade. The jar itself is very nice quality, a little weight to it, with thick plastic (?) and their signature lid. I dropped it once and it didn't break! I think it's worth it, if you have super dry under eyes like me and
Love how emollient this eye cream is, it just glides on your skin and leaves it feeling moisturized. Perfect for winter
This rich cream absorbed quickly, left my skin hydrated and so soft and smooth. It works great under makeup as well as overnight.

avis.titre: Giving it a longer chance but likeable
avis.texte: I use it day and night and I definitely think the puffiness has gone down but I need to give it more time I think to see better results with the darkness

avis.titre: BB makes the best eye cream primers!
avis.texte: I have been using BB eye creams for years to put under concealer for my dark circles. I have not found a cream to remove the dark circles, as for me they are hereditary , but this cream ( as well as its predecessor , the extra rich eye cream) are great concealer bases .I have tried other premium brands of eye creams and none work as well as a concealer base.

it only takes a tiny, tiny bit, and it works. tried it on my li ds, too, even tho it says it's for under eyes, but got a nice surprise. it does keep concealer on under eyes, but also makes eyeshadow last very well. moisturizes too.
I'm still on the fence with this eye cream. I've been using another brand sold at a competitor that has pigments to camouflage dark circles. I'll give this obe a little more time.
I use it am/pm. I love it. So glad Ulta had it on sale. I bought one for my daughter

I live for skin care / makeup . I have too much but never enough ! Finally got Bobbi's entire line with high hopes . Was not happy with outcome :( . As for this product …. It's not bad but it does nothing special . I would not purchase at full price or again . I don't understand why it's so hyped :(((( I have oily / combo skin . I was SOOOOO excited for Bobbi's line but none of her products have worked well with my skin / or have done anything special .

Best stuff I have ever used for under my eyes! I have oily skin so my undereyes are always creasing. Not with this. A little goes a long way. I saw comments of people saying their eyeshadow applied weird after putting this on their eyes. It does say it's for under the eyes in the description so maybe that's why.
Love how silky smooth this cream is. It's very light yet moisturizes well.
I cannot explain how amazing this really is!! Makes concealer under the eyes look beautiful throughout the day with no creasing!! Highly recommend

I normally use Lancome products for my skin care routine. But I needed a little more oomph when it comes to the skin around my eyes. So I did some research and found this BB product. So glad I found it because I have been using it in conjunction with my Lancome Genefique eye cream. BB Vitamin Eye Base Primer/Moisturizer is a fantastic addition to my morning routine, and helps to keep my concealer from sinking into my fine lines.

avis.titre: HG. Best scent, so emollient without greasiness, perfection
avis.texte: I have repurchased the Vitamin Enriched Face Base for years. It's sdomething I can't live without, so when I saw this-GRABBED. Just as satisfying! The cirusy scent is so refreshing and the perfect start to the day. I find this emollient without greasiness or having any affect on makeup application. I will be a lifer with this one as well!

This is the best eye cream I have ever tried right along with their face base primer and also the hydrating eye cream. I'm 40 and this stuff goes on amazing and my concealer is flawless with a nice natural soft glow.
